nodes.name: Question Bank
nodes.summary: Legacy comma-delimited draft question bank (769 rows) with per-member AI-themed multiple-choice questions tagged by Bloom's Taxonomy level (Knowledge/Understanding/Application/Analysis/Evaluation/Synthesis); superseded by the pipe-delimited MCQ/*.csv format decided in CONTEXT.md, with content still to be ported rather than discarded.
nodes.languageNotes: Comma-delimited with quote-escaping for fields containing commas/newlines; columns are Date, Last Name, Bloom Level, Lesson Code, Learning Resource Code, Question, four choices, Correct Choice, Explanation, Status.

nodes.name: CONTEXT.md
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for the 'How to Train Your AI' quiz game project: synthesizes the game proposal, assignment grading requirements, and team execution plan into core mechanics (Bloom-stage progression, protocols, scoring ladders, lifelines, end conditions), the decided pipe-delimited CSV data format, the assignment requirements checklist, and a timeline anchor.

nodes.name: How_To_Train_Your_AI_Plan_v2.md
nodes.summary: Team execution plan (v2) laying out the four team roles, the pre-coding CSV format lock and shared-class scaffolding, module ownership for question writing, and a week-by-week (Week 1 through final submission) schedule with integration gates and a project risk table.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Default VS Code Java project README describing the standard src/lib/bin folder structure and pointing to the JAVA PROJECTS view for dependency management.
